name: Geek Village
blurb: Indoor geek convention at Trixxo Arena in Hasselt with tabletop games, comics, anime, an artist alley and the Belgian Nordic Cosplay Championship qualifier.

editions.evidence: Page text: 'Geek Village The Con 14 & 15 November 2026 ... Trixxo Arena Hasselt [Belgium]'; 'Date: 14–15 November 2026 ... Address Trixxo Arena Hasselt 70 Gouverneur Verwilghensingel 3500 Hasselt Belgium'

notes: Geek Village also runs a summer open-air edition at Kasteeldomein Hex in Heers (per the batch note); the only trace of it found is a stale JSON-LD block giving 'Geek Village: Open Air Fair', 15–16 August 2026 — already over as of this 2026-10-05 check, with no 2027 Open Air date announced on any page found (no distinct Open Air page is currently live; the site's root domain and /the-con both show only the November Trixxo Arena show right now). Per the two-shows-a-year rule this stays one file, but only the one upcoming, confirmed edition (The Con, Nov 2026) is listed; the Open Air side is left for a future check once it reappears. The page promises 'special guests' as a feature but names none and no guests/guest-list page could be found (several plausible URLs 404), so guests is "none-yet".
